live.name: Cron
live.headline: Cron: a threat actor known from a catalogue entry and four tool names
live.in_short: Cron is listed in the ETDA catalogue with four associated tools. No public report in this library describes its operations.

sentences.t: Cron is a threat actor listed in the ETDA catalogue, which records no other names for it.
The catalogue lists four tools tied to Cron: Catelites, Catelites Bot, CronBot and TinyZBot.
No public report in this library describes its operations.

next.in_short: The catalogue lists Cron with four tools: Catelites, Catelites Bot, CronBot and TinyZBot. No report in this library describes the actor's targets, methods or operations, so this profile is short.

sentences.t: The catalogue records this actor under the name Cron.
The catalogue lists no aliases for Cron.
The entry comes from the ETDA catalogue.
The catalogue ties four tools to Cron: Catelites, Catelites Bot, CronBot and TinyZBot.
The catalogue entry gives no detail on what these tools do or how they are used.
Check the context before linking any report that uses the word cron to this actor, since the word can mean other things.
Tie activity to Cron only when a source names the actor or one of its listed tools.
